description.p: LLauncher is an unofficial launcher that installs, updates and runs Arknights: Endfield on Linux through Proton. It downloads the game from the official CDN, keeps it up to date, verifies and repairs game files, and manages a DWProton build tuned for the game — no manual Wine setup required.

ul.li: One-click install, update, verify and repair of the game
Automatic DWProton download with a recommended, tested build
Gamescope integration: upscaling (FSR/NIS), FPS cap, HDR
Wine prefix toolbox: winecfg, cache cleanup, back up and restore
Play statistics: session journal, weekly activity chart
Quick launch from the tray, desktop menu or the command line

description.p: Launching from the tray or the desktop action now checks for a game update first. Closing the window hides it to the tray so play statistics and the Flatpak wineserver clean-up keep working. Settings are written atomically, the launcher keeps its own log, launch and save errors are shown, and every dialog works with the keyboard.
Launch-crash diagnosis with actionable advice, multi-threaded archive extraction, per-file download retry, request timeouts, and a static-background fallback for systems without GStreamer.
Gamescope integration, Wine prefix toolbox, play statistics and quick launch.
